rationale: Adds a compact learned input-anchor mix to the existing reverse-tail carry path. The first reverse recurrent pass previously had no carry-anchor delta because x equals the decoder-output anchor; this gives that carry gate a small trainable x0 direction while preserving the current 9x512 recurrent-tail/export endgame, VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0, MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS, and exact final int8+zlib scoring. The returned wrapper executes the complete modified source embedded inside it.
title: Tail Input-Anchor Carry Unlock
